name: straddle front lever
description: A front lever hold with both legs straight and spread wide. Opening the legs shortens the lever compared to the full version.
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms and depress your shoulders.
Lift into an advanced tuck, then extend both legs out into a wide V.
Keep your body horizontal from shoulders to hips.
Point your toes and squeeze your legs straight.
Hold, then tuck your knees and lower with control.
